lines: Having made support-bearing wonder-taste-sprinkling-moment-washed taken by mind; by own nature flowers by own delight abundance; bliss nectar full own heart argha vessel succession you with goddess together in body temple abode worship god day and night.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kṛtvādhāradharāṃ camatkṛtirasaprokṣākṣaṇakṣālitāmāttairmānasataḥ svabhāvakusumaiḥ svāmodasandohibhiḥ ānandāmṛtanirbharasvahṛdayānarghārghapātrakramāt tvāṃ devyā saha dehadevasadane devārcaye@harniśam
